_readme: S393 SkySycamore, 2026-10-14. All 148 of Cerritos's associate-degree records hold the major only (record shape 6's Major only gap): no degree total and no general education units. Before writing Cerritos's reconcile steps (Sam, 2026-10-14: a secondary search of the catalog text after the harvest, each catalog its own steps; cpl_memory sam-reconcile-pass-after-harvest-2026-10-14), this read prints how a Cerritos degree page states the degree's total, its general education and its electives, and how the catalog's associate degree requirements page states them. Three loads, no model call.

questions.degree_total: Whether and how a degree page prints the degree total (60), apart from the major's total.
questions.ge_line: Whether and how a degree page prints the general education units for the degree.
questions.elective_line: Whether a degree page prints electives to reach the degree total.
questions.requirements_page: How the catalog's associate degree requirements page states the 60 units and the general education pattern.
